{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the distribution of customer_segment and customer_age across channels
cross_tab_segment = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])
cross_tab_age = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], pd.cut(sales_df['customer_age'], bins=[0, 30, 50, 100], labels=['<30', '30-50', '50+']))

# Output the results
cross_tab_segment, cross_tab_age"}
